gaps.sentence: Never have I ___ such a stubborn refusal.
gaps.explanation: Inversion: Never have I + past participle — never adds emphasis.

gaps.sentence: Nowhere ___ the report mention the missing funds.
gaps.explanation: Nowhere does the report mention… — present simple inversion.

gaps.sentence: So widespread ___ the outage that servers abroad noticed.
gaps.explanation: So widespread was the outage that… — inversion.

gaps.sentence: Only after the audit ___ the missing funds come to light.
gaps.explanation: 'Only after the audit did the funds come to light'.

gaps.sentence: So ferocious ___ the storm prove that three coastal villages were evacuated.
gaps.explanation: With the bare verb 'prove', the inversion takes do-support: did the storm prove.

gaps.sentence: Little ___ the chances of success be improved by patience.
gaps.explanation: Little will the chances be improved… — inversion with future.

gaps.sentence: Should you ___ any problems, call reception immediately.
gaps.explanation: Should you experience… = If you experience… — formal conditional inversion.

gaps.sentence: On no account ___ passengers open this door.
gaps.explanation: On no account should passengers… — formal prohibition.
